scenes.stage_direction: Adrian's surviving records reopen grief. Leave a pause around Amara's response; David does not speak over it.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He said it himself. Nobody is telling me what he would have wanted.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: His provision for Ethan was deliberate.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He mentions an emergency instruction. I remember an envelope I was told not to open yet.

metadata.evidence_summary: His commitment is no longer merely reported by others.
